topic: Effective date of the US GAAFET ECAD software control (August 2022 rule)
disagreement: Existing claim (BIS press release, 12 Aug 2022) says the ECAD control was effective 15 August 2022; the Federal Register DATES section says the rule was effective 15 August 2022 except ECCN 3D006 (GAAFET ECAD), effective 14 October 2022.
possible_reasons: press release gave the rule's general effective date and omitted the delayed date for 3D006
rationale: The Federal Register DATES section is the legal text and explicitly carves out ECCN 3D006.
remaining_uncertainty: None material; REG-0011's effective date should read 2022-10-14 for the ECAD control.

topic: Which allied countries are excluded from the December 2024 SME FDP licence requirements
disagreement: Reuters (July 2024, draft rule) reported that shipments from Japan, the Netherlands and South Korea would be excluded; the final Supplement No. 4 to Part 742 lists 33 countries including Japan and the Netherlands but not South Korea.
possible_reasons: draft vs final rule: scope changed before publication
different instruments: news report on a draft vs codified regulation
reporter may have equated A:5 membership with exclusion
rationale: Codified regulation (eCFR) governs; the news report described an unpublished draft.
remaining_uncertainty: Why South Korea was left out of the exclusion is not stated in sources read; whether Korean SME makers now need licences in practice depends on FDP product scope (see interview queue).

topic: Date of the Huawei Entity List designation (2019)
disagreement: Existing claim dates the Huawei listing to 15 May 2019 (Commerce announcement); the Federal Register rule 84 FR 22961 gives effective date 16 May 2019 and publication 21 May 2019.
possible_reasons: announcement date vs effective date vs publication date
rationale: Both are correct for different events; atlas pages should state which date is used.
